description: Burundi - Dams (Aquastat) is a dataset listed in Environmental Data Platform - Discovery (EDP - Discovery), a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.eurac.edu. Dam locations in Burundi extracted from Aquastat Dam database for Africa. AQUASTAT gathers detailed information about dams in each country, especially on location, height, reservoir capacity, surface area and main purpose. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include Burundi, bdi_energy_dams_aquastat_pp, features. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eurac-edp.
